title: Ansel and the Static
author: Mirabel Galloway
blurb: Hazel Zhou, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
